label: CAUSAL_CAPACITY_VERSUS_ACTUAL_EXERCISE_2: actual power transmission
term: causal power as actual modeled exercise or transmission
definition: `Profile.transmitsPower m w y x` is the supplied actual transmission relation from source y to target x at world w in one selected power channel. The separate `Coherent m` constraint requires both endpoints to exist there and the transmission to be an `Ontic.Causes` edge. The field alone entails neither condition. `Boundary` requires an actual source-to-effect edge as well as coherence; finite power grounding alone does not assert that edge.
note: Stipulative analyst relation for #319, not a reduction of physical production or an attributed source reading. The channel fixes one respect; no time parameter, simultaneous operation law, capacity activation law or bridge to esse is supplied. In #741, event occurrence and the exercise of a group record are separate fields of `JointGroups.Exercise`; they are not this source-to-target relation. See docs/power-existence-scope-boundary.md, Capacity and exercise vocabulary audit.

formal_gap.meaning: At the selected world, this source actually transmits the designated power to this target. Source and target range over the supplied Being type; the relation fixes the power channel. Its interpretation as productive activity is stipulated, not defined by the field type.
examples: In the first Boundary witness, at world false the source transmits to the effect; the conserver supports the source in esse through a different relation. This is a mathematical witness, not an observed causal process.
exclusions: An unexercised capacity; intrinsic source status without an outgoing edge; support of esse merely because it is support; a group record that is admitted or sufficient but not exercised.
open_obligations: Justify the productive interpretation and selected channel in an application; endpoint existence and causation require Coherent.
Supply explicit time, activation and respect correspondence before transferring conclusions to temporal processes or capacity possession.
A passage from transmission to existential support needs a separate premise; the boundary models supply no objection to that premise without further warrant.
